Days that deleted blobs and containers are recoverable. Point-in-time restore covers one day less.

Tenant ID that owns the Key Vault.
Log Analytics workspace resource ID for Key Vault diagnostics.
Number of days soft-deleted objects are retained.
Enable purge protection. Keep enabled for production workloads.
Allow Azure Resource Manager to retrieve secrets during deployments, required for az.getSecret() in .bicepparam files. Keep false for vaults that never back deployment parameters.
Apply a CanNotDelete lock to the vault (in addition to soft delete and purge protection).
Azure region for the hub network.
Hub virtual network name.
Non-overlapping hub address space.
Address prefix for the exact-case AzureFirewallSubnet. It must be at least /26 and contained in addressSpace.
Apply a CanNotDelete lock to the hub VNet.
Azure region for the firewall resources.
Azure Firewall name.
Azure Firewall Policy name.
Azure Firewall public IP name.
Azure Firewall subnet resource ID.
Log Analytics workspace resource ID.
Spoke CIDR ranges permitted to use the firewall DNS proxy and application rules.
Management subnet CIDR ranges permitted to reach OS update endpoints.
Approved outbound FQDNs for App Service traffic. An empty list denies application traffic by default.
Availability zones for the firewall and its public IP, for example ['1', '2', '3']. Zones are fixed at creation, so leave empty when updating an existing non-zonal firewall.
Firewall and policy tier. Premium adds IDPS (and TLS inspection, deferred by ADR-011).
Threat intelligence mode for the firewall policy.
IDPS mode for Premium policies: Alert logs signature hits, Deny also blocks them. Ignored for Standard.

Per-signature IDPS overrides for Premium policies, for example to Alert-only on one signature that false-positives against legitimate traffic. Find the signature ID in the AZFWIdpsSignature table's SignatureId column. Each entry: { id: '<signatureId>', mode: 'Alert' | 'Deny' | 'Off' }. Empty by default; never used to disable IDPS as a whole (use idpsMode = 'Off' for that, which this project does not do).
Apply CanNotDelete locks to the firewall, its policy, and its public IP.
Existing firewall policy name in this resource group.
Spoke CIDR ranges permitted to use the firewall DNS proxy, Azure Monitor egress, and approved application rules.
Management subnet CIDR ranges permitted to reach OS update endpoints (Windows Update, Ubuntu archives).
Approved outbound FQDNs for application traffic. An empty list deploys no application allowlist.
Azure region for the spoke network resources.
Spoke virtual network name.
Non-overlapping spoke address space.
Firewall private IP used for App Service egress and VNet DNS proxy traffic.
Log Analytics workspace resource ID for VNet diagnostics.
CIDR ranges allowed to reach private endpoints over HTTPS. The caller derives these from subnet prefixes so they cannot drift.
Private endpoint subnet name.
App Service integration subnet name.
Private endpoint subnet address prefix.
App Service integration subnet address prefix.
Virtual machine subnet name.
Virtual machine subnet address prefix.
Apply a CanNotDelete lock to the spoke VNet.
CIDR ranges allowed to reach management VMs over SSH (22) and RDP (3389), such as AzureBastionSubnet or the P2S VPN client pool. An empty list denies all administrative inbound traffic.
Virtual network name
Virtual network location
Array containing defenstack vnet address space(s)
Array containing DNS servers for defenstack

Name of the App Service integration subnet.
Name of the virtual machine subnet.
Enable delete lock
Enable diagnostic logs
Storage account resource id. Only required if enableDiagnostics is set to true.
Log analytics workspace resource id. Only required if enableDiagnostics is set to true.
Azure region for the App Service plan and application.
Globally unique App Service application name.
Delegated subnet resource ID used for App Service regional VNet integration.
Log Analytics workspace resource ID for App Service diagnostics.
Deployment environment that controls App Service plan sizing.
Relative path probed by App Service health check; it must return 200-299 when the instance is healthy.
Spread plan instances across availability zones. Zone redundancy is set when a plan is created, so enable it only for new plans.
Number of plan instances. Zone-redundant plans require at least 3.
App Service plan name. Include the environment and region so every stamp gets its own plan.
Azure region for the VM resources.
Virtual machine name. Use 1-15 characters because the name is also used for the computer hostname.
Operating system image to deploy.
Subnet resource ID for the VM network interface.
Local administrator username. Do not use reserved Windows administrator names.
SSH public key for Linux deployments. Required when osType is Linux.
Local administrator password for Windows deployments. Required when osType is Windows.
VM size selected for the workload.
Log Analytics workspace resource ID for VM diagnostics.
CIDR ranges allowed to reach the VM over SSH (22) and RDP (3389). Must match the management subnet NSG; an empty list denies all administrative inbound traffic.

performanceCounters.name: perf
performanceCounters.counterSpecifiers: [if(equals(parameters('osType'), 'Linux'), createArray('\Processor(*)\% Processor Time', '\Memory(*)\% Used Memory', '\Logical Disk(*)\% Used Space'), createArray('\Processor Information(_Total)\% Processor Time', '\Memory\% Committed Bytes In Use', '\LogicalDisk(_Total)\% Free Space'))]

variables.osLogSource: [if(equals(parameters('osType'), 'Linux'), createObject('syslog', createArray(createObject('name', 'syslog', 'streams', createArray('Microsoft-Syslog'), 'facilityNames', createArray('auth', 'authpriv', 'daemon', 'kern', 'syslog'), 'logLevels', createArray('Warning', 'Error', 'Critical', 'Alert', 'Emergency')))), createObject('windowsEventLogs', createArray(createObject('name', 'windows-events', 'streams', createArray('Microsoft-Event'), 'xPathQueries', createArray('System!*[System[(Level=1 or Level=2 or Level=3)]]', 'Application!*[System[(Level=1 or Level=2 or Level=3)]]')))))]

storageProfile.imageReference: [if(equals(parameters('osType'), 'Linux'), createObject('publisher', variables('linuxImagePublisher'), 'offer', variables('linuxImageOffer'), 'sku', variables('linuxImageSku'), 'version', 'latest'), createObject('publisher', variables('windowsImagePublisher'), 'offer', variables('windowsImageOffer'), 'sku', variables('windowsImageSku'), 'version', 'latest'))]

properties.osProfile: [if(equals(parameters('osType'), 'Linux'), createObject('computerName', parameters('vmName'), 'adminUsername', parameters('adminUsername'), 'linuxConfiguration', createObject('disablePasswordAuthentication', true(), 'ssh', createObject('publicKeys', createArray(createObject('path', format('/home/{0}/.ssh/authorized_keys', parameters('adminUsername')), 'keyData', parameters('adminSshPublicKey')))))), createObject('computerName', parameters('vmName'), 'adminUsername', parameters('adminUsername'), 'adminPassword', parameters('adminPassword'), 'windowsConfiguration', createObject('enableAutomaticUpdates', true(), 'provisionVMAgent', true())))]
